objective: fix a shell script that prints the wrong total

worker.instructions: `sum.sh` should print the sum of 1..4 but prints 9. Copy /in/seed/sum.sh into your workspace, fix it so `sh sum.sh` prints exactly 10, and keep it a shell script. Read files from /in/seed/ (read-only); your own /workspace is writable. When the task is done, call final_result alone with a short summary and route `done`.

seed.run: sh -c "printf '%s\n' 'i=1' 'total=0' 'while [ $i -le 4 ]; do total=$((total + i - 1)); i=$((i + 1)); done' 'echo $total' > sum.sh"
